pcs.pc_description: inspect the work area and ensure it is safe and clean with adequate lighting and ventilation and as per the safety regulations, to enable repairs to be carried out efficiently
ensure availability and serviceability of standard tools and equipment including supporting workshop facilities ; consummables needed for engine and power train repair work
assist in inspecting the machine sequentially for visible damages /deficiencies and leaks in the engine and and power train systems; report as necessary
check all levels of fuel, coolant and oils in engine, hydraulic and transmission systems; top up if necessary
assist in starting the machine as per procedure and checking the defect/fault reported in the engine and and power train systems
select and position all tools and equipment needed to remove the defective parts as identified during the fault diagnosis
remove , as instructed , defective parts of the engine and power train system without damaging surrounding components and assemblies
disassemble the parts, laying it out sequentially, as per procedure to facilitate re- assembly later
assist in inspecting the removed/disassembled parts and identifying those that can be reused/repaired/ replaced as applicable
assist in preparing the list of parts for procurement including consumables, preliminary work order and time schedule
clean all the disassembled parts using the appropriate tools and consumables as per manufacturers guidelines
replace or repair the affected parts, test functionality on bench as applicable and refit / reassemble the same as per the manufacturers guidelines
assist in starting the machine as per procedure and testing to confirm the defect/fault has been rectified
assist in starting the machine as per procedure and testing for leakages, unusual noises and general performance to corroborate with operators feedback on the equipment
ascertain the availability of necessary parts and consumables and assist in preparing tentative maintenance plan including approximate costing and time schedule

assist in carrying out all maintenance/service tasks as applicable on the equipments engine and and power train systems as per manufacturers specifications and procedures, ensuring only genuine and approved parts and consumables are used.
assist in starting the machine, post repairs and service, and conducting trial runs to check the performance of engine and and power train systems
store the tools and equipment, post usage, at the designated places and ensure they are not left behind in the repair bay
dispose the defective parts, consumables and waste as per the organizational policies & environmental regulations
assist in completing and submitting the requisite reports and documents as per the organizational policies and procedures
